text:
alex: Heads up — provisioning request for eu-central2 account. We need HA NAT across 3 AZs + subnet sizing for a new dedicated GPU tenant (reserved capacity). Asking for EIP quota bump, more private IPs per ENI, and explicit AZ affinity for GPU instances. Can infra team kick off support tickets?

maria: @alex can you paste the target CIDR plan and expected peak concurrent vCPUs / GPUs? also which instance families (A100/V100 etc)? :eyes:

alex: Plan: we want one hub VNet with three public subnets (one per AZ) and three private worker subnets. CIDRs: 10.40.0.0/22 (public), 10.40.4.0/21 (workers) split into /23 per AZ. Expected peak: 120 GPUs (A100-ish), ~1500 pods, need 2 elastic IPs per AZ for active/standby NATs. Prefer to reserve AZ affinity so GPU placement stays local for bandwidth.
jamal: FWIW AWS default Elastic IP quota is small in some accounts. We'll need a request: increase EIP per region to 12 (3 AZs x 2 + buffer). Also increase VPC ENIs per instance or IPs per ENI depending on instance types. If using p4d-style instances, they need large ENI quotas.

infra-bot: Automated checklist: found existing account limits: EIP limit=5, EC2-NAT-GW per AZ limit unknown, ENI limit=380 per region. Suggest opening Support Case: service-quotas request for EIP, ENI, and GPU instance quota. Template available in #eng-infra.

olga: Two notes: 1) NAT Gateway is simplest but costly at cross-AZ data transfer. If we put NATs in each AZ and prefer AZ affinity for data egress, ensure route tables are AZ-scoped and subnets pinned. 2) We should increase secondary private IP quota on ENIs so k8s can attach many pods/ENIs.
sre-oncall: Also check TGW route limits if traffic will egress via central hub. Central egress with single TGW could be simpler than per-account NATs, but TGW attachment limits and route table entries become relevant. We might hit 50k routes if we do per-tenant segmentation.

maria: Suggested Support Case body (paste/edit):

```
Subject: Quota increases for eu-central2 - EIP, ENI, EC2 GPU instances
Account: <REDACTED-account-id>
Requested increases:
- Elastic IPs (VPC) from 5 -> 12
- EC2 instances (p4/p5 family) quota from 0 -> 40 (for initial) and request burst to 120 within 60 days
- Network Interfaces (ENI) per region increase to 1200
- Private IPv4 addresses per ENI increased to support 50 pods/ENI on target instance types
- NAT Gateway quota per region increase if necessary
Reason: Dedicated GPU tenant onboarding for Redwood Dedicated; requires AZ affinity and predictable egress IPs for customer allowlists.
Attachment: subnet plan and cost estimate
```

jamal: I'll file the Support Case and link here. We should also run a quick cost calc: 3 NAT-GWs x 24/7 + cross-AZ data transfer vs. central egress via TGW. I'll drop numbers in here later.

alex: Please set ticket priority to "business-critical" and tag with account-owner + security so KMS / allowlist requests don't stall. Also need guidance on AWS PrivateLink endpoints for the customer's S3 interface — that'll need interface endpoints in each AZ and ENI quota checks.

infra-bot: Support Case created: 1234567890. ETA: initial response in 12-24 hours. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567890

olga: Quick config snippet for subnet split if helpful: 
```
public: 10.40.0.0/24, 10.40.1.0/24, 10.40.2.0/24  # one per az for NAT
workers: 10.40.4.0/23, 10.40.6.0/23, 10.40.8.0/23 # /23 per AZ for nodes
```

jamal: Cost note: NAT GW hourly *and* per-GB. For heavy egress consider egress via partner interconnect or regional peering to avoid public NAT costs. We'll model in spreadsheet.

maria: From security: if we need static egress, allocate EIPs to NATs and add firewall ACLs. For PrivateLink, we'll need to approve interface endpoints in each AZ — ask customers for allowed CIDRs so we can set up VPC endpoints.

sre-oncall: One operational ask: add healthchecks and automated failover for NATs. If an AZ loses NAT, route tables should fail to local standby, not cross-route to another AZ to avoid unpredictable latency.

alex: Thanks team — jamal, please post support case updates here. I'll update the subnet/cidr doc and share with solutions eng. :thumbsup:
